run_partimagenet_clip_name: run the partimagenet_clip_name module to generate CLIP text embeddings for PartImageNet categories
run_clip_text_embeddings: run the script with --prompt photo to generate CLIP text features using 'a photo of a' prompt templates
save_clip_embeddings_npy: save CLIP text embeddings to a numpy file using --out_path argument
run_clip_with_custom_model: run the module with --clip_model ViT-B/16 to encode text features using a Vision Transformer CLIP model
run_clip_no_prompt: run the script with --prompt none to generate CLIP embeddings without any prompt prefix
